title: Nullish coalescing (??) versus ||
hook: ?? returns the right-hand side only when the left is null or undefined — unlike ||, which triggers on any falsy value including 0, "", and false. Picking the wrong operator breaks config defaults and form handling.

blocks.text: **a ?? b** evaluates to **b** only when **a** is **null** or **undefined** (nullish). Otherwise it returns **a**. **a || b** returns **b** when **a** is any falsy value (false, 0, -0, 0n, "", null, undefined, NaN). **??** cannot mix with **||** or **&&** without parentheses — SyntaxError due to precedence ambiguity.

entries.plainDefinition: Returns first truthy operand; falsy triggers right side.
Assign right side only if left is nullish.

blocks.text: User settings with legitimate 0, empty string, or false break when || supplies defaults. API query params like ?count=0 need ??. React useState(0) with || default wrongly resets. C# **??** matches JavaScript nullish semantics for null only; JS adds undefined.

blocks.title: ?? vs || rule of thumb
blocks.body: Use ?? for "missing" defaults. Use || when any falsy should fall back (rare in config — usually explicit checks).

sections.heading: How it works step by step

items.title: Nullish test for ??
items.body: If left is null or undefined, evaluate and return right.

items.title: Truthy test for ||
items.body: If left is falsy, return right; else return left.

items.title: Parentheses required
items.body: Mixing ?? with || without parens is SyntaxError.

diagram.title: ?? vs || decision

snippet.label: 0 and empty string
snippet.explanation: || treats 0, "", false as missing. ?? only null/undefined trigger default.

snippet.label: Config merge pattern
snippet.explanation: ?? preserves explicit 0 port. null/undefined pick defaults.

snippet.label: Precedence trap
snippet.explanation: Parenthesize when mixing ?? and ||. Chain ?? for fallback chains.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Using || for numeric/string defaults when 0 or "" valid. Mixing ?? and || without parentheses. Replacing all || with ?? without reading falsy intent. ??= on property that should reset to 0.

interviewTakeaways: ?? triggers only on null or undefined.
|| triggers on all eight falsy values.
Use ?? for config defaults preserving 0 and "".
60s: ?? nullish only. || any falsy. port 0 example. Chain ??. Parens when mixing.
commonPitfalls: Weak: "?? and || are the same." Strong: "|| replaces 0 and ""; ?? only null/undefined."
Weak: "count || 10 is fine always." Strong: "Show count=0 breaking || — use ?? for numbers."
Strong: "Explain SyntaxError mixing without parens — language forbids ambiguity."

jsTsCorrelations.note: TypeScript types ?? narrowing: result excludes null/undefined from left when right taken.
C# ??= same idea; JS ??= only for nullish — undefined included in JS.
